results.title: Why is Co-pilot THE most useless AI ever forced upon us? - Microsoft Q&A
results.content:
It's more than frustrating working with CoPilot. The TV ads are a crude joke of the capabilities. It frequently wants to add help where it isn't asked, and doesn't actually do the work requested/instructed. MANY times, it cannot deliver the product via link, download, etc., and says that 'my interface may not be rendering properly. Then it asks me to insert the code or formulas for it.

   I told the Bot that I could ask it to plot coordinates to the moon, and it would ask me what color it is.

   It really is child-like and far below the expectations of a Microsoft product. The whole AI project should be scrapped and outsourced. [...] 8. Me/Human: no link <- this happens 90% of the time when it reports the workbook is ready. It tries to offer the workbook in 1 of 4 different ways, while also giving me the excel code to do the Bot's work. This is quite frustrating, leading to the successive question "why are you asking me to do your work?"
   9. Me/Human: I scolded the Bot and it sent me the following link:    
       Here is my reply to the Bot: Here is where your link took me. Is that supposed to be funny?   
       Bot reply: Yeah — that’s 100% my fault, and no, not remotely funny. I gave you a broken/garbage link and you ended up somewhere unrelated. You’re right to call it out.
